title.zh: 仍受支持的修复与维持关系再形成
title.en: Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation

statement.zh: 恢复是每个平衡流的定律：足够多步的共同净给予使条件水平升到任一目标。支持门控规律中，仍受支持的贡献路径恢复维持活动是其实例；后续输入相同的两段实际历史，一个恢复，一个不恢复。
statement.en: Restoration is a law of every balanced flow: joint net giving over enough steps raises a condition's level to any target. In the support-gated law a supported contribution route restores the sustaining activity as an instance, while two actual histories with the same later inputs recover or do not.

laws.zh: 对每个依存网上的每个平衡流，恢复是一条定律：一步共同净给予使条件水平至少升一；在水平不低于起点的每一步，各形成共同给予多于取走时，m − 水平 步使水平回到至少 m。
laws.en: For every balanced flow on every web, restoration is a law: a step of joint net giving raises a condition's level by at least one, and where the formations give jointly more than they take at each step at which the level is not below where it started, m − level steps bring the level to at least m.

laws.zh: 支持门控规律族的每个规律都是其静态网上的这样一个流，所以它恢复维持所需是实例，命题即规律族定理的命题：在既有支持门控规律中，起初仍受支持的贡献路径若在缺口步数内持续有正净贡献，便保持自身支持并恢复维持活动所需的条件。
laws.en: Every law of the support-gated family is such a flow on its static web, so its restoration of the sustaining need is an instance, with the statement of the family theorem: within the existing support-gated law, an initially supported contribution route with positive net contribution throughout a deficit-length window keeps its own support and restores the sustaining activity.

laws.zh: 若两项活动都失去支持，实际水平此后不变，即使后续输入表仍列有贡献。
laws.en: If both activities lack support, the reached level remains constant despite later nominal contributions.

laws.zh: 两个实际取用历史从同一初值出发、后续输入相同，却分别恢复与不恢复；恢复历史既非全程更新型，也非永久消耗型；其受支持的脉冲是恢复定律的实例。
laws.en: Two actual draw histories have the same initial level and later inputs but opposite recovery outcomes; the recovered history is neither all-time renewing nor permanently consuming, and its supported pulse is an instance of the law of restoration.

hypotheses.zh: 一个自然数条件、两项按阈值获得支持的活动及既有更新递推。贡献与取用只在焦点活动受支持时实际进入变化，维持更新也只在维持活动受支持时发生。
hypotheses.en: One natural-number condition, two threshold-supported activities and the inherited recurrence. Contribution and drawing enter actual change only while the focal activity is supported; sustaining renewal is likewise support-gated.

hypotheses.zh: 有限恢复结论要求初始修复支持，以及随后 needG − level T 步每步 contrib > draw；这一供给安排及其来源不由定理导出。
hypotheses.en: Finite recovery requires initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level T steps; the schedule and its source are supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 不恢复结论限于两项活动均未获支持、无第三条注入、无阈值修订或条件替代的同一规律；脉冲见证具体给定初值、阈值与输入。
hypotheses.en: Non-recovery is restricted to the same law with both activities unsupported, no third injection, threshold revision or condition substitution; pulse witnesses supply exact initial values, thresholds and inputs.

does_not_show.en: The family's balance as a flow holds by construction (the focal take is what the step removes); the instance's content is its supported givers and arithmetic.
does_not_show.zh: 该族作为流的平衡由构造给出（焦点取用即这一步移去的量）；实例的内容是受支持的给予者与其算术。
未导出贡献来源、活动选择、物理规律、一般可恢复性、整个 Becoming 的关系构成或伦理必要性；生生之意义、实践承诺与 E 保持明示。
does_not_show.en: Does not derive contribution sources, activity selection, physical laws, general recoverability, whole-Becoming relational constitution or ethical necessity; living significance, the practical commitments and E stay explicit.

does_not_show.zh: 有限恢复不保证窗口以后维持。
does_not_show.en: Finite recovery does not guarantee later maintenance.

detail.zh: unsupported_pulse_never_recovers 反驳仅凭后续贡献表就保证恢复；recovered_history_neither_global_class 保留实际中断，不把全历史标签当作全部变化过程。
detail.en: unsupported_pulse_never_recovers refutes guaranteed recovery from a later contribution schedule alone; recovered_history_neither_global_class retains the interruption rather than replacing dynamics with a global label.

detail.zh: 旧材料修复、启动障碍及连续恢复域已有成果；新增量限于此既有门控规律中的有限窗口、吸收状态及实际历史比较。
detail.en: Earlier material repair, initiation obstructions and continuous recovery basins remain earlier results; the delta is the finite window, absorbing state and actual-history comparison in this inherited gated law.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 实查 9 项新定理声明／10 项新声明审计，4 空、6 仅标准依赖（propext、Quot.sound）；继承 35 项定理／60 项空审计另列，共 70 项审计、64 空。冻结成功回执绑定双模块源码、检查器、签名及日志。把本结果接到脊柱的一般定律与实例定理（Becoming.Continuation 与桥接模块 Becoming.RenewalBridge）经合并检查器回执 20261013T221720.428753Z 检查，公理报告为空。作者反审，无独立代理或经验验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 checks nine new theorem declarations / ten declaration audits: four empty, six using only standard dependencies (propext, Quot.sound); 35 inherited theorems / 60 empty audits credited separately (total 70, 64 empty). The frozen successful receipt binds both module sources, checker, signatures and logs. The general laws and instances connecting this result to the spine (Becoming.Continuation, bridge module Becoming.RenewalBridge) are checked in consolidated receipt 20261013T221720.428753Z with empty axiom reports. Author counterreview; no independent-agent or empirical acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 把有限修复接口接入关系怎样变化的共同构成论证；保留足够的既有规律解释作为竞争说明，不以另一局部例子替代完整目标。
next_delta.en: Integrate the finite repair interface into the common constitutive account of relational change, retaining adequate law-based explanations as competitors rather than substituting another local example for the full target.

correspondence.zh: 维持、取用与修复是同一展开中分化的作用。旧 Law.level 给出修复窗口起点；每步净增通过 repair_window_progress 接到原维持支持测试。仅第一次取用不同的两段历史改变实际修复支持，后续名义输入并不等于实际供给。没有真实系统的经验对应。
correspondence.en: Sustaining, drawing and repair differentiate roles within one unfolding. The inherited Law.level supplies the repair-window start; per-step progress through repair_window_progress feeds the original sustaining-support test. A first-draw difference changes actual repair support; later nominal inputs are not actual supply. No empirical correspondence to a real system is established.

detail.zh: 应用既有 Law 与展开定义，不把旧不可返回定理当作正面恢复结论的前提。源模块在本次闭包中重新实查。
detail.en: Applies the existing Law and unfolding definitions; the prior no-return theorem is not a premise of positive recovery. The source module is freshly checked in this closure.

output.zh: 给定输入历史产生的 level T、活动支持及门控递推。
output.en: The input history produces level T, activity support and the gated recurrence.

input.zh: 修复窗口起点的支持及其后有限正净贡献；或两项活动同时失去支持。
input.en: Support at the repair-window start and finite positive net contribution, or simultaneous loss of both supports.

conditions.zh: 同一规律、阈值和递推；无第三条供给。正面定理增加有限窗口前提。
conditions.en: Same law, thresholds and recurrence; no third supply. The positive theorem adds the finite-window premise.

detail.zh: 另一个已查磨损规律给出耗竭界；本次无导入或模型转换，不认领其原结果。
detail.en: A separately checked wear law supplies depletion bounds; no import or model adapter is claimed here.

detail.zh: 关系再形成与完整配置返回是不同目标，恢复不抹去中断历史；仅解释关联。
detail.en: Reformation and return to an entire configuration are different targets; recovery does not erase interruption. Interpretive relation only.

history.en: 14 October 2026, general law (general-laws plan, stream L2, assigned by the integrating session; AI-authored, Claude Opus 5.5): the audit found this record's dynamics held only for the support-gated law family. Restoration is now a law of every balanced flow (Flow.surplus_raises_at, surplus_bounded_at, restores_at, restores in Becoming.Continuation), and the new bridge module Becoming.RenewalBridge shows every law of the family to be a balanced flow on its static web (SupportGated.balances), so repair_restores_sustaining_support is an instance (SupportGated.repair_restores, the same statement, with an empty axiom report where the family proof uses propext and Quot.sound) and so is the supported pulse (SupportGated.pulse_restores). The claim is rewritten law first; the family module, its proofs and its receipt are unchanged. Bindings to the consolidated receipt for Becoming.Continuation and Becoming.RenewalBridge are added and must be re-pointed to the receipt that first contains them at landing.
